model_explanation: S1 says Bill is the only person Sam gave grapes to, so S2's claim that Sam also gave Sue grapes contradicts this.
if Sam gave oranges only to Sue, then he did not give oranges to Rob; S2 follows from S1.
S1 restricts who got grapes (only Rob) but says nothing about what else Rob might have received; oranges are not ruled out or implied.
if Tom only got oranges from Sam, then Tom did not get bananas from Sam; S2 follows from S1.
S1 says Ellen is the only person Sam gave bananas to, so he cannot also have given bananas to Mary.
if only Ellen received grapes from Sam, then Tom did not receive grapes from Sam; S2 follows from S1.

S1 restricts what fruit Rob got (only oranges) from Sam, so giving Rob apples would contradict that; however, “only gave Rob oranges” is naturally read as “only oranges (to Rob), possibly also to others,” not “Rob got nothing but oranges.” Under that standard reading, S1 does not speak about non-orange gifts, so S2 is independent.
if Sam gave only apples to Tom, then he did not give Tom grapes; S2 follows from S1.
